content: Meera Chauhan called Anita Sharma at Trust Wealth Advisors to reinstate her expired auto policy. Anita offered two options: reactivating the old term or starting a fresh 12-month term. Meera opted for a new 12-month term. After discussing discounts, Anita applied a safe-driver discount, bringing the total premium to $1,150. Anita confirmed Meera's address (45 Greenfield Ave, Bangalore) and VIN (1HGCM82633A004352), processed the payment using the card on file, and successfully activated the policy.
